question: Choose the odd one out: **(17, P, #), (13, J, !), (19, R, %), (23, V, @)**
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bfeb8251e59d40b272fc555c55a6dbcaf7e2920ff45b313d810401a05714305.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Number - letter position = 1**

(17, P) → 17 - 16 = 1 

(13, J) → 13 - 10 = 3 (odd one)

(19, R) → 19 - 18 = 1 

(23, V) → 23 - 22 = 1 

So, the odd one is (13, J, !).

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 2.**
